Portrait setting: A Tokyo shopping street at night. Behind the character, tall buildings close in on both sides, their faces stacked with neon signs and light boxes reduced to unreadable color shapes; giant video billboards high above show costumed pro heroes in bold poses. The street recedes into the distance, lit on both sides, with a few distant passersby as blurred silhouettes. No readable signs or text.
